thread:
Maya (AE): NovaRetail needs a perf run for short sessions (1-3s) with repeated microbursts up to 250 qps for 20-45s, then long idle. They want p50/p95/p99, error %, cold vs primed, and KMS notes. Can SE/Eng propose harness + quick cost delta?
Sam (SE): Clarify model variant? open-13b-q4 or similar? tokens ~200 total? Streaming ok?
Maya (AE): They said ~13B quantized, ~200 tokens. No strict streaming requirement.
Sam (SE): Proposed sequence: 1) cold burst (no warmup) 45s@150qps; 2) priming 5m@50qps; 3) burst sweep 45s at 50/100/150/200/250 qps with 3m idle between. Capture p50/p95/p99, errors, GPU util, tokens/sec. We'll include cold vs warm delta.
Sam (SE): Example harness (adjustable): ./microbench --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/generate --model open-13b-q4 --seq 200 --burst "45s@250,180s@0" --repeat 5 --out metrics.csv
Devon (Eng): Runtime recs: prefix_cache.enabled=true, prefix_cache.size_mb=200, batch.max_tokens=2048, batch.time_ms=8, async_kv_prefetch=true. Enable autoscale.burst_buffer with cooldown 120s. For Dedicated recommend reserved pool sized for steady + 25% headroom.
Devon (Eng): Reference numbers (internal): 30s@250 -> p50~80ms p95~220ms p99~420ms err~0.3% gpu~75%. Cold-first-burst p95~540ms err~1.6%.
Priya (Security): KMS: we support customer KMS/HSM in Dedicated/Private. Need to confirm rotation cadence, offline wrapping, and load-generator IP allowlist. Fed-like controls -> Private deploy + audit retention, affects cost/timeline.
Maya (AE): Pricing ask from Tom: what's the incremental cost for this bursty traffic vs standard per-token?
Sam (SE): Quick EoE: hosted per-1k tokens example $0.12. Bursty without reserved can add ~1.2-1.7x effective cost due to idle/warm. Small Dedicated reserved pool reduces delta to ~1.05-1.25x. Will produce exact table once we choose cluster size.
Tom (Prospect): We can provide two 2-hour windows this week. Want cold vs warm comparisons and a short runbook for our infra. Also confirm keys stay in our KMS for Dedicated.
Sam (SE): We'll export CSVs + charts + runbook. For Dedicated keys remain in your KMS. Priya will follow up on details.
Maya (AE): I'll schedule Wed 10am PT. Sam/Devon confirm harness and I'll send invite.
deploy-bot: Scheduled run 4781234567-job for 2026-03-25T10:00:00-07:00 (queued).
Maya (AE): Thanks — will share metrics + pricing note after run.
